text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (Woooooaaaaaaahhh--!!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I won... I was supposed to have won, and 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I can't get that running form I caught out 
of the corner of my eye out of my head. I 
just can't forget that fierce drive to 
contend.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Why am I feeling so frustrated...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Geez, you're totally right.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you won, didn't you? At least say 
you're happy about it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Aren't you frustrated? I took first 
place in the Derby from you, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I stole the "coolness" you were aiming 
for, didn't I?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Then I'll just take it back.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
By surpassing you, the one who beat me in 
the Derby, I'm gonna become even cooler 
than before.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Until then, you'd better stay as "cool" as 
you possibly can.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...In the end, I'll be the cool one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the way back—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …………She's gonna "take it back" from me.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaah------!!)

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
What a brilliant run. No other words could 
possibly describe her!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
The number one Umamusume who will live 
forever in people's memories—!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...What is with her?! What, what, what! 
She's the one who lost! I was supposed to 
win!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Why is it that all I can picture in my 
head is her crossing the line in first 
place?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...What do you mean, 'cool'... I really 
don't understand...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —That night.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer. Sorry for contacting you 
so late.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I hate leaving things like this. I want 
to beat her one more time.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I won't let her take 1st place...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to fall behind her any 
further. So train me thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to become the "Number One" who 
won't lose to her...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet's eyes sparkled with a fiery 
brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She might not see the final destination of 
the "Number One" she aims for just yet. 
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Going down this path, I feel like I've 
found a clue in my search for an answer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Next up is the 'Shuka Sho.' The final leg 
of the Triple Tiara."
